human_economic_burden.boundary: A source-reported measured lower bound; it is not multiplied across the mapped compacted share and is not assigned a monetary value.

source_locators: Scale and Bulk Density sections: more than 6,000 measured LUCAS 2018 samples underlie the continental packing-density assessment.
Impact summary: crop-yield reductions greater than 35 percent have been measured and effects remained detectable 17 years after one compaction event.
Soil compaction slide: 3.2 percent of arable land is classified as compacted using packing density as the proxy.
Dataset description: 6,140 samples at 0-10 cm and 5,684 samples at 10-20 cm from LUCAS 2018, spatialized to 100 m across the EU and UK.
Key findings: croplands have almost 1.5 times higher bulk density than woodlands; model R-squared is 0.66.

transformations.formula: Use the EUSO-reported 3.2 percent arable-land compacted class derived from the LUCAS bulk-density measurements and packing-density model; do not infer compaction from agricultural activity alone.
Use 35 percent as the conservative numeric value for the source statement that measured crop-yield reductions exceeded 35 percent; do not multiply it by area.
Use the source-reported 17 years for detected yield and nitrogen effects after a single compaction event.
Normalize the 28 directly represented EU and UK countries; do not generalize the regional assessment globally.
0.35B + 0.30H + 0.20P + 0.15E; convert to 1-10 with 1 + 9 × composite and round to one decimal.

receipts.uncertainty: Packing density is a modeled proxy derived from bulk density and clay content, and the published model reports R-squared of 0.66. The 3.2 percent compacted share applies to arable land in the European assessment domain, not all agricultural land globally. The greater-than-35-percent yield reduction and 17-year persistence are measured evidence summarized by ESDAC, but they are not asserted to occur at every compacted LUCAS pixel. EU-27 plus the United Kingdom is used only as the represented assessment coverage.
receipts.freshness: LUCAS samples collected 2018; EUSO assessment reviewed 2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: The European Soil Data Centre assessment combines thousands of measured bulk-density cores with a documented packing-density model and quantifies compacted arable-land share, measured yield loss, persistence and bounded continental coverage.
higher_priority_failures: The 2018 regional survey does not supply a current global field-level aggregation.
No method-comparable 20-year annual or 60-month global series supplies current magnitude plus threshold or momentum coverage.
